key_insight: The paper turns partially identified estimation problems into entropy-regularized multi-marginal optimal transport, enabling efficient computation of sharp bounds with Sinkhorn iterations.
engineering_relevance: It provides a practical and scalable way to compute partial-identification bounds in statistical models where exact parameter recovery is impossible or ill-posed.
method: Reformulate infinite-dimensional linear programs as optimal transport problems on path spaces.
Add an entropy penalty to obtain a multi-marginal entropic OT problem.
Solve the regularized problem efficiently with Sinkhorn iterations and analyze convergence/statistical rates.
evidence_signal: The authors validate computational and statistical properties in simulations and demonstrate an application to demand estimation.
watch_item: Regularization makes the problem tractable but introduces approximation error, so entropy strength and convergence diagnostics must be chosen carefully.
paper_title: Partial identification with entropy regularized optimal transport
